missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Армия' stays in the nominative case as the subject. 'Российская' is the agreeing feminine adjective, and 'большая' is the predicate adjective describing its size.

Strategic focus: Accusative of direction. 'Армию' is the accusative object after 'в' showing movement into military service. 'Пошёл' agrees in masculine gender with 'брат'. A very common phrase about conscription.

missions.phrase: Он служит в армии два года.
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Prepositional of location. 'В армии' uses the prepositional form 'армии' after 'в' to show being inside the institution. 'Служит' is the typical verb, and 'два года' gives the duration.
Strategic focus: Genitive of belonging. 'Армии' is the genitive form showing whose commander it is. 'Командир' is the nominative subject, and 'приказ' is the accusative object of 'дал'.
Strategic focus: Instrumental after гордиться. 'Армией' is in the instrumental case required by 'гордится'. 'Своей' is the agreeing feminine possessive, and 'страна' is the nominative subject.
Strategic focus: Prepositional after об. 'Об армии' uses the prepositional 'армии' to express the topic of writing. 'В газете' is also prepositional, naming where it is written.
Strategic focus: Genitive singular after a numeral. 'Армии' follows 'две', which requires the genitive singular form. 'Встретились' is plural, and 'на границе' is prepositional, marking the place.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Армии' is the nominative plural subject after 'многие'. 'Используют' agrees in the plural, and 'новую технику' is the accusative object.
Strategic focus: Dative recipient. 'Армии' is in the dative case as the recipient of help after 'помогает'. 'Своими деньгами' is instrumental, showing the means of help.
Strategic focus: Accusative direct object. 'Армию' is the accusative object of 'любит'. 'Свою' is the agreeing feminine accusative, and 'народ' is the nominative subject.
